vision.name: Black Ambush
vision.text:
([Trait:Namekian] or [Trait:Saiyan] only.)
[Attack] 2: Physical attack.
Focused. Your next Styled attack this combat gains "Focused."
DAMAGE: 4 life cards and 4 stages.
HIT: Raise your anger 2.
(Rejuvenate after use.)
(Created by Trevor Morris, OP4 Grand Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP5 folder; credit line names OP4 Champion); restriction icons: orange N badge (Namekian) and green S badge (Saiyan) read from the sheet; stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge
